item.title: Opponents march against California Forever
item.description: Solano Together, a coalition opposed to California Forever, hosted a march with Facebook group California ForNever in opposition to the development company’s annexation proposal in Suisun City on Saturday. Roughly 90 marchers gathered at the Suisun City Walmart and marched west along Highway 12 to downtown Suisun City, where they met up with other protesters for a rally.
